name: Tiny Ltd.
blurb: Tiny is a Canadian holding company that owns a diversified portfolio of businesses, primarily in the internet and technology sectors, with a focus on the Shopify partner ecosystem. Its subsidiaries include Pixel Union, Out of the Sandbox, Yopify, SuppleApps, Rehash, Foursixty, and Stamped, offering software-as-a-service, digital goods, and services to Shopify merchants. The company operates on a decentralized management model, with corporate leadership concentrating on capital allocation and investment decisions. Tiny generates most of its revenue from North America and Europe.
recent: In the past 30 days, Tiny announced conditional approval to graduate to the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX), along with a proposed share consolidation and intention to implement a normal course issuer bid. The company also reported its fourth quarter and full year 2022 financial results, though specific details were not provided in the sources.
